reason: An AirTag or a kids' watch does most of what this does for a fraction of the money. On top of the therapy and medication I already pay for, another $20 a month for a data plan is hard to justify, and I'd want to know a live camera is worth paying that every month.
objection: I can't tell if the live video and talk feature is something I'd use often enough to justify $249 plus $240 a year, when a $29 tracker already shows me where he is.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial or a month-to-month plan I could cancel, plus proof from other parents of autistic kids that the live view actually helped them find a wandering child quickly.
